forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {熟|じゅく}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: For fruit or crops to reach the stage where they are ready to eat or harvest. Used for the natural ripening process.

definitions.gloss: to mature; to come to fruition (figurative)
definitions.explanation: For a plan, idea, skill, or situation to develop to the point where it is ready or complete. A figurative extension of the ripening metaphor.

examples.japanese: ⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧{熟|じゅく}した。
⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ほど{熟|じゅく}した⟦{柿|かき}→柿：04384_kaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I gathered persimmons that had ripened enough to fall from the tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{熟|じゅく}して⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{青|あお}くて→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧。
examples.english: Bananas that haven't ripened yet are green and hard.
To wait for the right moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}そう→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Let's reach a conclusion after the discussion has matured.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}し、⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確立|かくりつ}→確立：13758_kakuritsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Through years of experience, their skills matured, and they established their own style.

notes:
Godan verb (さ row): {熟|じゅく}す・{熟|じゅく}します
て-form: {熟|じゅく}して
た-form: {熟|じゅく}した

Also read as ⟦{熟|う}れる→熟れる：30499_ureru⟧ (ichidan verb), which is more common for the literal ripening of fruit.

KEY EXPRESSION:
⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}す — "The time is ripe." A very common set phrase meaning the right moment has arrived.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{果実|かじつ}→果実：00146_kajitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}す (fruit ripens)
- ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}す (the time is ripe)
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}す (the discussion matures)
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|じゅく}す (a plan comes to fruition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{熟|う}れる→熟れる：30499_ureru⟧: The native Japanese reading, specifically for fruit ripening. More colloquial than {熟|じゅく}す.
- ⟦{成熟|せいじゅく}→成熟：12638_seijuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: To mature — more formal, used for people, societies, or markets reaching maturity.
